handoff_payload.answer_text: Gross margin is not a useful metric for American Express because it is a financial-services company, where interest expense, credit-loss provisions, and operating expenses are more informative than a traditional cost-of-goods-sold margin. In FY2022, revenue grew 24.7% to $52,862 million, but expenses grew faster at 31.4% and provisions for credit losses increased to $2,182 million, driving the post-provision operating margin down to 18.9% from 24.4% in FY2021.
